approvedVisualRule.requiredExterior: Real iPhone 17e product photo in Black, White, or Soft Pink.

approvedVisualRule.sameInwardFaceReuse: Allowed only among iPhone 17e color variants after the inward face is verified as exact iPhone 17e.
